notes.title: ★ Optimization Report ★
notes.notes: [p]With the autumn's breeze comes a new adventure—stylists, are you ready? ٩(๑>◡<๑)۶[/p][p]We've been working hard on the optimizations you care about most. Here's the latest scoop on what's coming in the new version![/p][p]\[Home Optimizations][/p][p]Optimization for Home continues! The following are enabled in the current version:[/p][p]● Undo Function for Construction: No more panic over mistakes—simply revert your last action anytime for flexible building![/p][p]● New Yardling Prompts on Map: Instantly spot upgradable Home Abilities and claimable Home Journal rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Coming in Version 1.10, more quality-of-life upgrades to enhance your Home experience:[/p][p]● 3 New Ability Presets: Configure and switch between ability wheels as needed—use a dedicated Home preset on the Home island![/p][p]● Enhanced Furniture Snapping: More snap points are added and detection for floating distances is refined, ensuring a smoother placement experience for stylists![/p][p]● \[Give in Person] Gift Option: Deliver gifts face-to-face during co-op sessions for heartfelt moments with friends.[/p][p]● Animal Following: Invited animals now tag along as you explore your Home.[/p][p]Other highly requested features are also under development, including placeable teleport points, material previews for furniture sketches, and so much more in future updates![/p][p][/p][p]\[Other Optimizations][/p][p]● Co-op Icons Upgraded: Interaction invites now feature dynamic icons and text, so it's instantly clear what your friends want to do.[/p][p]● Improved \[Glow Up] Filtering: Added filtering by \[Outfit Collection Status] to help you find your target outfit faster.[/p][p]● \[Scroll of Splendor: Purification] Setting: Added an \[Artwork Display] toggle so you can decide whether to show the painting effect.[/p][p]● Screenshot Function Upgrade: Now supports Snapshot Mode—even while using \[Whimsicality] abilities! Adjust lighting, change focal length, and more to capture every perfect moment.[/p][p][/p][p]More optimizations are on the way—please stay tuned for future in-game announcements. We'll keep rolling out optimizations in upcoming versions, with special focus on the Home system that many stylists care deeply about. We hope to bring you an even better gameplay experience![/p][p]As always, you can share feedback and suggestions with us through various channels, or simply leave a comment below. We'll keep collecting your feedback to guide future optimizations. Stylists, thank you for your support and companionship![/p]

notes.title: ★Behind the Scenes: Music Season's Sound Design★
notes.notes: [p]The stage lights are bright, and music fills the air.[/p][p]Strings resonate as the drums drive the rhythm, carrying the audience along every step of the way.[/p][p]Welcome to Music Season, where a grand musical celebration awaits all our stylists![/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Dramatic Performance in Sound[/b][/p][p]To let our stylists truly feel the atmosphere of Music Season, we designed this season's sound with one goal: everything happens within the drama. Every note, every effect tells a story.[/p][p]The form that brings this idea and the music itself to life is musical theater.[/p][p]It's a wonderfully broad genre. From mid-19th-century operetta to the latest Broadway hits, and even German, Austrian, and French musicals, styles may differ widely, yet they all fall under the banner of musical theater. This creative freedom was exactly what we needed to explore interactive musical storytelling. While the game copy may call this season's music "opera," from a stylist's perspective, it's really musical theater in the broadest sense. We also chose French for some pieces because it strikes a perfect balance between traditional opera and modern musical theater. Its pronunciation shines in both classical and musical-theater styles and perfectly complements the Baroque- and Rococo-inspired visuals of this season.[/p][p]To fully immerse stylists in the drama, our sound design was rooted in theatrical performance. We aimed to capture the feel of a live stage while adding a touch of stylized, dreamlike expression that lifts it beyond reality.[/p][p]We call this "interactive musical theater"![/p][p][/p][p][b]1.1 A Truly Immersive Experience[/b][/p][p]Once you enter the theater, the heart of the story comes alive through the performers, both puppets and the troupe leader. For this season, we crafted individual vocal lines for each NPC, using the layered point-source and scene-music synchronization techniques we first experimented with during Revelry Season. Each track originates from its NPC, so in the theater, whether during a level or a boss fight, seeing a character means hearing them perform right before your eyes. Step back, and the sound naturally softens, just as it would in real life.[/p][p]The first time you step onto the Box Theater stage, Jacob sings from the left and Melissa from the right. When Gina, the violinist, takes center stage, her part joins the ensemble, recreating the sensation of being on a real stage during rehearsal. During the chase sequence, every NPC sings as they appear, moving around the stylist as they perform. They pause when hit, and when the performance concludes, their voices fade, leaving the theater quiet once more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/b6fdcbfef289d5605c46da6d46dfc6f71f36c57c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is the magic of immersive theater. The performers are not far away on a stage, but right beside you, their presence vivid and alive.[/p][p]During the boss battle, stylists wearing headphones will hear the singing always coming from the stage, just as if they were seated in a real theater. The sound flows through the space, making every note feel tangible and real.[/p][p]By the final performance, stylists witness Nikki step onto the stage, singing with her whole heart. Her voice awakens the puppets and stirs the old troupe leader, carrying the story to a soaring, unforgettable climax. This sequence was crafted like a cinematic musical, full of intensity, beauty, and emotion.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1.2 The Art of Auditory Expression[/b][/p][p]Beyond realism, we wanted to present stylists with a richer auditory experience through abstract and expressive artistic techniques.[/p][p]When you can see the performers, you hear their singing clearly and vividly. But even when they are out of sight, the accompaniment continues to linger, creating a sense of presence and continuity. In addition, the actions of the puppets during levels and the visual effects of musical notes in boss battles are carefully timed to the rhythm of the music. This reinforces the feeling of being inside a performance that is both immersive and slightly surreal—familiar yet dreamlike, not entirely bound by reality.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/088dd5cbf673c66a1aba54dbbb9c818d396bfa16.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stylists familiar with film might notice how many classic works move seamlessly between narrative and non-narrative sound. In our interactive musical theater, we weave these two layers of sound together, synchronizing them and bringing them to life in a way that only this medium can achieve.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Narrative Sound Design[/b][/p][p]With the performance style established, it was time to craft the sound. Every member of the team, music composers, sound designers, and audio engineers, came together, weaving their talents to tell this story. Through carefully layered melodies, subtle effects, and immersive audio techniques, they brought the drama to life, letting every note and every sound carry the emotion of the scene.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2.1 The Box Theater[/b][/p][p]In the story, tragedy strikes, leaving the troupe leader trapped in an endless cycle of guilt. The opera itself becomes a perpetual loop, caught in this haunting repetition.[/p][p]The first time you enter the Box Theater, a roughly thirty-second musical loop plays continuously. If you linger, you begin to notice it—this subtle repetition hints at the puppets' presence, endlessly performing this fragment of obsession. Near the stage, Melissa, Jacob, and Gina sing, their voices precisely rendered with 3D point-source audio. Renita, however, remains unseen until the theater tips on its side.[/p][p]Even out of sight, her coloratura soprano line lingers, delicate and persistent. Step farther from the stage, and her solo drifts across the theater, echoing with a haunting, almost otherworldly presence that fills the space long after the performance seems to end.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/2b21f4a6c9f6dccd6636832a44d3216eb8f6efb2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After the Box Theater tips, the music shifts, unfolding into a full variation of the piece that once played on stage, looping endlessly. The NPCs' pursuit of Nikki reveals a singular truth: [b]each puppet carries the troupe leader's obsession[/b]. One by one, they appear, perform for their only audience, Nikki, and bow when their act concludes. As more puppets join, the performance swells, richer and more vibrant. Yet when their acts end, silence falls, leaving only the lingering echoes of the accompaniment. The contrast is stark, mirroring the troupe leader's grief: from a bustling, joyful stage to the hollow emptiness of being alone. The music loops endlessly, trapped in a cycle with no escape.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/416da231cdbb4a77bddb6d41566f238eb980cc53.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"Till We Meet Again", once the troupe's most celebrated song, now rises in a bright, full orchestral arrangement, yet its lyrics tell a story of farewell. It becomes a quiet confession, as if the puppets themselves are singing their own story alongside the notes.[/p][p]Attentive stylists may notice the eerie creaks of the puppets as they move. We used the sound of joints rubbing and wooden parts shifting to evoke how stiff and unnatural their bodies have become after being forced into this endless cycle. As Nikki passes, their sudden twitches, paired with these haunting sounds, create an uncanny, almost spine-chilling effect.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2.2 The Boss Battle[/b][/p][p]Nikki's purification of Ennio from Dark Essence mirrors his inner journey, moving from the weight of guilt and despair toward tentative warmth and release. The music captures this struggle, weaving together contrasting themes of pessimism and optimism, despair and hope, destruction and renewal. These opposing forces unfold through intertwined melodies and two distinct voices, carrying the drama and intensity of traditional opera.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/803d8f7a2283f09a235ad8e0709ca41512801e81.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the first phase, only Ennio's solo fills the air, steeped in sorrow and despair. When Renita enters in the second phase, they form a duet. High and low vocal lines converse in a canon-like dialogue, echoing and reflecting each other as hope and despair collide in song. The third phase introduces electronic textures. Distorted, warped sounds mirror the increasingly chaotic struggle between Ennio and hope. His fury crashes like a relentless tide, challenging stylists with every surge.[/p][p]Renita, overflowing with emotion, delivers intricate coloratura soprano passages in both the second and third phases. Her commanding voice overcomes the despair on stage, dispelling the last remnants of Dark Essence and restoring light to Ennio's heart.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2.3 Black-and-White Cutscene[/b][/p][p]This black-and-white animation unfolds like a storybook slowly opening, with music that narrates every twist and turn in a gentle, fairy-tale voice.[/p][p]At first, the stage is minimal, delicate. The celesta's crystalline melody twinkles like a ballerina spinning inside a music box, endlessly circling the stage. A tender female voice joins in duet with a graceful violin, as if the Evermelody Troupe's former performers are bringing their favorite roles to life. Ennio, ever present, is the solitary cello in the shadows, quietly accompanying his beloved companions.[/p][p]But as Ennio's emotions stir, his obsession ignites like wildfire. Painful memories surge, and the violin erupts with jagged, anguished notes that never cease. The night of joy collapses, leaving him trapped in unending regret and confusion. The lonely cello finally sings its own sorrowful melody. In a desperate attempt to relive the happiness he once shared with the troupe, Ennio lets obsession take hold, summoning back the voices of the past. The female voice and violin return, now joined by a swelling tapestry of instruments, no longer elegant but raw, anguished, as if crying, steeped in dark energy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/fae139b2072948f28136b7acb3570bc671a91c56.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Even as Ennio recreates the Box Theater, he knows it is an illusion. In the final music, we return to the simple, pure melody from the beginning, freezing that fleeting beauty in this very moment. This time, the melody is carried by the cello rather than the celesta and voice. Though the Evermelody Troupe performs the familiar scene once more, all that has passed has already drifted far from Ennio…[/p][p][/p][p][b]2.4 Final Performance[/b][/p][p]As a two-minute cutscene, this sequence naturally differs from a full two-hour musical. Traditional musicals often center on well-known songs that reveal characters' inner monologues, with delicate emotional progression. Dialogue between songs drives the story forward, which works beautifully on stage, but doesn't suit the fast-paced emotional flow needed for a cutscene. For the first half of The Chant That Shall Cross Beyond Eternity, we introduce Nikki's perspective.[/p][p]She narrates the tale as if looking back on long-past events, guiding the audience through the rise and fall of the troupe. Then, at the pre-chorus, the troupe's puppets suddenly take the stage. This shift in storyline and performers interrupts Nikki's narration, and together with all the characters, she drives the story into the chorus—the heart of the performance: don't let the melody freeze on the eternal shore; let our souls reunite in flowing music. In the chorus, the arrangement becomes rich and fluid, moving beyond traditional orchestration to blend modern synthesizers with flowing musical details. Nikki's musical-theater singing merges with the puppets' operatic voices, creating a seamless fusion of old and new. It's a reminder that we can honor the past, but we must not stop moving toward the future.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/a9e8641762e8aa08994e06f84a0a1dcd937f0b96.jpg"][/img][/p][p]P.S. Nikki worked incredibly hard on her singing and sounds amazing![/p][p][/p][p][b]3.[/b] [b]Nikki's Performance[/b][/p][p]Before we go into detail about Nikki's performance, here's a quick fun fact. While idling in the open world, Nikki sometimes hums to herself. Occasionally, Momo can be heard humming along as well.[/p][p]Creating a musical is far more complex than composing purely instrumental music or standalone songs. It is no longer just musicians collaborating. Writers, directors, and performers all play a role. For this project, I wore many hats like I did back in Firework Season for Echoes of the Past. I arranged and composed the music, but I also stepped a bit into writing and directing while keeping a close eye on music direction throughout.[/p][p]Once the script team handed me the rough story outline, I created a detailed narrative script that followed the music's storytelling logic. That included planning pacing, segment breakdowns, lyric summaries, plot twists, and character cues. I then coordinated with the video director to time character entrances and vocal moments. During recording, I guided the singers and musicians in acting and performance, almost like rehearsing a mini musical myself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/6de25669ca5702c1db4c1b526cbbdc6f5a77862b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As for inspiration, it is hard to explain. Because I love musicals and had done plenty of preparation, I already had a clear sense of opera structures and emotional flow. Then I saw Nikki, her face and her stunning outfits, and the melodies just poured out. Before I even realized it, the demo was finished. I was beyond excited.[/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Music Season in Florawish[/b][/p][p]During Music Season, Florawish comes alive with countless bands and performers, including Morda's Faewish Sprite Band from Revelry Season and the human band that plays outside the Stylist's Guild every night. To prevent audio clashes between ambient music and live performances while boosting immersion, we brought back our layered point-source and scene-music synchronization technology.[/p][p]As you wander through the performance zones, you'll notice the music flowing seamlessly. Ambient tracks and live band sounds merge effortlessly, never competing. Even when Florawish's French chansons collide with the Faewish Sprite Band's ragtime, the wildly different styles coexist perfectly, creating a vibrant, dynamic soundscape.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/d5070ddcc7896c473c6d66f4c2889e52033e90a6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]5. Richer and More Diverse Musical Styles[/b][/p][p][b]5.1 Rhythm Game—Have Fun Playing Music![/b][/p][p]Yes! Stylists finally get to revisit some of the amazing music we've created over the past year! (Ahem… okay, let's get serious.)[/p][p]For the rhythm game, we didn't just pick our personal favorites. After extensive research, we chose tracks that stylists love, that fit perfectly with the world's lore, and that deliver the best gameplay experience. Working closely with our game designers, we went all out to craft over 20 tracks, including two brand-new songs made exclusively for the rhythm game![/p][p][/p][p][b]5.1.1 The Unstoppable Super Star Cat[/b][/p][p]Creating a theme song for Momo was pure joy. This is Momo's musical debut in Infinity Nikki, so we definitely wanted to make it something special.[/p][p]Starting the song was trickier than expected. I wanted it catchy, cool, and sprinkled with traditional Chinese flair. Too many goals at once can make your brain freeze, but if you don't start, nothing happens. Wise words from a certain cat. So I just dove in.[/p][p]I tried all sorts of styles before landing on a "rock meets traditional Chinese" mashup. The rock and Momo's vocals bring the swagger, the melodies stick in your head, and the suona with his operatic-style flourishes gives it that cultural punch. It is playful, lively, and just a little mischievous, exactly like Momo. And the suona adds the cherry on top, giving his signature silly, spirited charm. Thanks to everyone on the team contributing ideas, this song turned out better than we expected![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/a588380562dabf2826314a38d52978acb692aa78.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]5.1.2 Whimsicality Waits for No One[/b][/p][p]The idea for this track was born during a meeting. While reviewing research data, we realized just how wildly popular the Whimstar jingles were. (Whether that popularity came from genuine love or pure annoyance... well, the jury's still out on that one.)[/p][p]At the same time, we were discussing the need for some custom-made tracks for the rhythm game. And really, what rhythm game would be complete without a proper “boss” track? The moment we pictured one of those cheerful jingles transformed into a fiery, over-the-top remix, the decision was sealed. Our mischievous music designer immediately declared that three Whimstar jingles would be remixed into one gloriously overblown "boss" track.[/p][p]Disclaimer: It wasn't created to be cruel, more for dramatic effect. That said, during the very first playtest, even the designer was reduced to tears by the difficulty.[/p][p][/p][p][b]5.2 \[Echoed Dreams]: Ultimate Retro, Endless Possibilities![/b][/p][p]The core musical style for Music Season's outfits is rooted in the grandeur of Baroque art. As one of the pinnacles of Western music after the Renaissance, Baroque is celebrated for its ornate beauty, emotional depth, and dramatic intensity—qualities that make it the perfect vessel for expressing ideals of splendor and magnificence. When the visual direction for Music Season was set, our designers quickly realized that Baroque's grand scale, rich ornamentation, and bold expressiveness were a natural fit. These qualities highlight the intricate detail of the outfits themselves while deepening the artistry and immersive atmosphere of the season as a whole.[/p][p]For the ability "Echoed Dreams", we orchestrated four instrumental families comprising 16 instruments in total: flute, oboe, clarinet, and bassoon; French horn, trumpet, trombone, and tuba; ensemble violins I & II, viola, and cello; plus celesta, glockenspiel, vibraphone, harp, and an additional harpsichord track.[/p][p]The music is structured in SATB polyphony—soprano, alto, tenor, and bass—where the main melody flows between voices, shifting modes along the way. This interplay captures the layered elegance of Baroque composition. And for those who manage to trigger all four voices in perfect SATB order, a hidden surprise awaits: a harpsichord melody, the hallmark sound of the Baroque era.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/4f4b776b3d5a41fb546371e372f6a237610af54a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]5.3 \[Counterflow Concerto]: Move to the Rhythm![/b][/p][p]This is our first time incorporating the electric guitar, a fully amplified instrument, into the musical style of an outfit. From the very beginning, we wanted to give stylists a truly unique experience. We recorded both "Clean" and "Distortion" guitar tones and introduced the Power Chord feature, a highly expressive technique commonly used in pop, rock, and other modern music styles. We also designed a playful, rhythm-focused gameplay element that emphasizes the energetic beat, "boom boom boom da," creating a striking impact for stylists that is both visually engaging and aurally exciting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/d9f4631c4c9962d2a0407efa5496f05c289395a8.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ⭐Behind the Seams | [Echoed Dreams] The Inspirations Behind the Designs
notes.notes: [p]The overture swells and the stage is set. A dazzling performance beloved across Miraland is about to begin![/p][p]Feathers tremble, casting sparks of gold; skirts twirl to the rhythm, tracing arcs of brilliance. As music and dance entwine, the curtain rises on the "Echoed Dreams."[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Story Behind the Outfit[/b][/p][p]Eternal Farewell[/p][p]The heavy curtain finally fell, the old suitcase snapped shut.[/p][p]Within the silent Box Theater, the last glimmer on her face was swallowed by darkness...[/p][p]Twelve years spun on in endless circles, and the days blurred the edges of what had been. Only one promise remained—like a thread hung from above, drawing her to sing day after day: to become the greatest troupe in history and to complete the grandest tour across Miraland. In the name of "Eternity," that melody was kept alive.[/p][p]She believed it with all her heart—until the costume she had never worn appeared again, and that familiar tune slipped into the air.[/p][p]The past stirred in the dust. Along with it came a name: Lorelei.[/p][p]How dear that troupe had been—family in all but blood, companions who shared every laugh. Under the banner of Lorelei they had spent six years together, bringing joy to countless audiences until at last they stood on the stage of their dreams.[/p][p]On the eve of that performance, her fingers had traced over a mailed sketch: an exquisite classical gown blooming on paper. Beside it, her younger brother had copied out a carefully written melody, ink still fresh. It was the most precious gift she had ever received.[/p][p]Yet the letter of happiness she prepared in return was never sent—an abrupt dash, a fated turn frozen into eternal regret.[/p][p]She watched the troupe rise from obscurity to glory; she watched the crowds swell from a few to thunderous halls; she watched all they had built with their own hands collapse in roaring flame.[/p][p]No one remembers Renita. No one knows Lorelei.[/p][p]The song she sang in the blaze should have been her final offering to the stage. Instead, memories sank into a fog. Some four thousand days scattered like grains of sand, drifting on endless winds of time. The companions inside the suitcase remained as they were, while the man who carried them was robbed of years in solitude.[/p][p]With his life, he had forged a dream as fleeting as moonlight on water, obsessively preserving a beautiful memory that could never return. But that same devotion became a spell that chained his soul to the past: there was no laughter, only unending remorse and a river of tears.[/p][p]This was never what she had wished for. The joy she wanted to spread, the happiness and melodies she longed to share—these were not meant to be imprisoned in an unchanging "eternity." When would he finally see that?[/p][p]Outside the suitcase, the scratch of pen on paper slowed and then stopped. At last a long sigh broke the silence—a sigh so heavy it seemed to carry twelve years of unlifted chains. It was the prison the guilt-stricken man had built for himself, binding the rest of his days.[/p][p]"Let it remain in the past... Along with all the other old things." A frail, hoarse voice whispered.[/p][p]The soul that had wandered so long in regret finally chose to let go.[/p][p]The long, intoxicating dream drew its final curtain. At last it was time to say farewell.[/p][p]My dearest friends, my beloved family... perhaps in another life we will meet again—if another life awaits.[/p][p]Farewell, to the past. Farewell to the dream that is no longer eternal.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Inspiration Behind the Design[/b][/p][p]For this five-star outfit we wanted to fuse the lavish ornamentation of Rococo and Baroque fashions with the vibrant, fantastic beauty of the Nikki series, creating a truly gorgeous, elegant, and luxurious ballroom gown. Imagine the finest satin, intricate, layered embroidery and glittering jewels—the hem sweeping across the stage carpet with a soft "swish." From that atmosphere we built the gown's overall framework and then filled it with detailed touches, ultimately presenting the "Echoed Dreams" outfit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/3a738a77f1d903835768347e22bb5fcd44a2323e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Details in the Design[/b][/p][p][b]\[Headwear & Hair Accessory][/b][/p][p]One of the most memorable traits of Baroque fashion is its unapologetically oversized headwear, so we leaned into that Baroque excess—yes, the headpiece is deliberately grand. Staying true to the musical theme, it incorporates pipe-organ motifs to form a magnificent, castle-like silhouette. Feathers dusted with flecks of gold shimmer as they drift, adding to the opulent allure. As a standalone hair accessory, they can also be mixed and matched for versatile styling.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/ad6d89eeaa83747591f1a636e5bf867918fd6309.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Hair][/b][/p][p]The hair echoes Rococo silhouettes with complex braids and ornate chignons. The most important goal was to avoid a wig-like appearance while keeping the flamboyant complexity of the style. For this and every Nikki hairstyle we carefully design every strand around the face—lively, natural curls that still read as a polished, styled look. Above all, the hair flatters and frames Nikki's face, magnifying her beauty.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/d6c6d1c60ae2fb1d0f8c8aa2edcf28b31a13ca9e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Dress][/b][/p][p]The silhouette follows classic Rococo/Baroque proportions: a traditionally cut bodice and sleeves paired with a versatile, ornamental piece around the neck that enhances the dress' grandeur and highlights Nikki's delicate features. The skirt weaves in many musical motifs to echo the outfit's theme. To capture the original concept of "a sumptuous train falling across the stage," the lowest tier uses dazzling sequined fabrics that catch the distant, luxurious stage lights. The asymmetric side train is a focal flourish, adding movement and liveliness to the layered skirt, and the skirt patterns subtly hide small, clever musical details.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/877c111cce38163fe3b4b8f5ac579c22c830d54c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/8d1f46305788e07fffdd32a4643064ee821cc5d5.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Shoes][/b][/p][p]Inspired by classical ballroom footwear and musical elements—and developed with the art team's creative input—these refined dance shoes complete the look. During a lyrical performance we don't want Nikki to be straining on her toes, but the shoes still need a bit of lift to support the voluminous skirt, so we discreetly raise the platform just enough to strike the right balance between comfort and silhouette.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/0ef0749b755a3df81171e7a24e48a76aca8de6a4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Concept Behind the Abilities[/b][/p][p]The outfit's ability is centered on an operatic performance that ties directly to its aesthetic—letting melody and movement weave freely across the open world.[/p][p]Once equipped, you can summon a Melody Carpet in the open world, and even invite friends to join you in a music-filled dance spectacle. Each note-tile on the Melody Carpet lights up as you step across it; elegance and joy unfold together—follow the flowing notes and enjoy a delightful musical interlude with your companions.[/p]

notes.title: ♾️ Home Optimization Report | More Improvements Coming Your Way!
notes.notes: [p]With the launch of Version 1.9 Music Season, the all-new Home feature is finally here![/p][p]This feature was born from a shared wish between stylists and the Devs: to give Nikki a little place to rest and recharge between her adventures in Miraland—a cozy world all her own.[/p][p]We want this space to be full of freedom, self-expression, and beauty.[/p][p]Here, Nikki can let her Whim run wild, build her forever home, decorate, plant, fish, and just be carefree.[/p][p]She's never alone either, always surrounded by friends who care about her, both old and new, including the Junimo and animal companions![/p][p]This is the perfect place for stylists to let their creativity shine, and we can't wait to see all the amazing creations you'll bring to life![/p][p][/p][p]Since the launch of the Home system, we've been keeping a close eye on your experiences and have received so much valuable feedback. Thank you all for sharing your thoughts, impressions, and suggestions! We're carefully reviewing everything, evaluating it, and planning the right optimizations. Some improvements need extra rounds of stability testing and compatibility checks to make sure everything runs smoothly and reliably when they go live. We really appreciate your patience and support while we make your Home experience even better![/p][p][/p][p]At this time, we'd like to share with you the latest updates and upcoming plans for the Home feature:[/p][p][b]Home Warp Locations and QoL Improvements[/b][/p][p]We noticed that many of you often need to visit Posy to check Home Abilities or access the Yardling Shop. To make things more convenient, we've added a teleportation location for the Astral Tree, making it easier to reach Posy. In the future, we also plan to add [b]moveable teleportation locations within your Home[/b], so you can get around more freely.[/p][p]In addition, we've made a few quick fixes to improve your overall experience:[/p][p]● Fixed incorrect furniture quantities displayed in the Crafting Table inventory.[/p][p]● Resolved an issue where higher-level furniture appeared in Yardling Purchase's "Top Weekly Picks" even if players weren't able to craft them yet.[/p][p]● Corrected cases where Meteorites appeared in unreachable spots after using the Star Collecting ability.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Construction Features and Home Notification Improvements[/b][/p][p]One of the most requested features is finally on its way—an [b]Undo[/b] option in the Construction mode! It's currently in development and is expected to arrive in Version 1.10. Soon, you'll be able to let your creativity run wild and experiment freely without worrying about mistakes.[/p][p]If you're still getting the hang of furniture placement and rotation, don't worry! You can fine-tune everything in Settings—[b]turn on snap placement, adjust Single Movement Distance, and set Single Rotation Distance[/b]. As your Construction Ability grows, you'll unlock even more powerful tools like [b]Batch Placing, Floating Construction, Clipping Construction, Free Rotating, and Free Resizing[/b], giving your creations endless possibilities.[/p][p]We've also heard your requests for an overhead view while building. Once your Construction Ability reaches a certain level, you can combine it with Gliding Ability to unlock [b]Floral Construction[/b], letting you control the camera freely while placing furniture. We're keeping an eye on reports about obstructed views during Floral Construction and will carefully evaluate if any tweaks are needed.[/p][p]In addition, you'll now see [b]notifications whenever Home rewards are ready to claim or Home Abilities can be upgraded[/b]. This feature is set to roll out during Version 1.9.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Ability Wheel Enhancements and Ongoing Improvements[/b][/p][p]We'll continue enhancing the Home feature based on your feedback, making the experience smoother and even more enjoyable! With the addition of the Home Abilities, the current Ability Wheel isn't quite big enough to cover both open world and Home needs. In a future update, stylists will be able to customize and switch between 3 different Ability Wheel loadouts, making it easier to be ready for any situation. Other optimizations already in the works include:[/p][p][b]● Adding default Home templates.[/b][/p][p][b]● Displaying the amount of Astralites.[/b][/p][p][b]● Adjustable volume controls for the Chicken Gramophone.[/b][/p][p]We're working hard on these improvements, so keep an eye out—they'll be coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]We've also received the following requests:[/p][p][b]● The ability to preview crafting materials when buying furniture sketches.[/b][/p][p][b]● The option to enter Realm Challenges directly from Home.[/b][/p][p]We're reviewing each of these suggestions carefully and will keep you updated as soon as we have a plan, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]If you have more ideas or suggestions for the Home feature, feel free to reach out via the official @InfinityNikkiEN account, the email [url="https://infinitynikki_cs@infoldgames.com"]infinitynikki_cs@infoldgames.com[/url], or through in-game Customer Support. Every bit of feedback you give us helps make Miraland even better! We'll keep refining the Home feature, improving gameplay, and enhancing core activities like planting and construction, so that our stylists can create a Home that feels cozy, peaceful and full of warmth.[/p][p][/p][p]Nikki's latest adventure in Miraland has just begun, and the Music Season is still in full swing. On this journey, we hope everyone can enjoy the beauty of music, unleash their creativity alongside Nikki, and create memories in Miraland that will last a lifetime. And remember, when all is said and done, Nikki's Home will be waiting—a cozy place for her to rest and recharge, before setting off on the next adventure![/p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/12f7477ea2c1334b1a9cb8dac0eb2a0fbc31142d.jpg"][/img]Over 999 free furniture pieces, battle pass fully refunded, and take photos in the open world to claim sketches for free![/p][p]You've probably already seen the previous preview and may already be familiar with the Home system. To answer some of your questions and satisfy your curiosity, the Special Home Q&A is here—let's take a look![/p][p][/p][p][b]Miraland Round Table: Special Home Edition[/b][/p][p]Over 999 free furniture pieces, BP fully refunded, and take photos in the open world to claim sketches for free![/p][p]You've probably already seen the previous preview and got a sense of the Home system. To answer some of your questions and satisfy your curiosity, the Special Home Q&A is here—let's take a look![/p][p][/p][p]Q: How to get furniture? And how much can we get for free?[/p][p]Over 999 free items are available to decorate a cozy dream home![/p][p]With the Version 1.9 update on September 2, the Home system goes live. To give stylists a rich and convenient first Home experience, we're gifting a large amount of free furniture and furniture sketches! Here's a summary of how to get some of the free furniture and sketches in the current version:[/p][p]Ways to Get Free Furniture:[/p][p]1. Island Arrival Bonus:[/p][p]Receive 999+ free furniture pieces the moment you arrive on the island! Over 100 types included for you to mix, match, and unleash your creativity.[/p][p]2. Decor Catalog:[/p][p]Take photos of specific furniture in Miraland to obtain the corresponding furniture sketches—over 90 sketches available![/p][p]3. Home Management:[/p][p]Accumulate Astralites and level up your Home abilities to exchange for 300+ furniture sketches from the Home NPC Posy. Unlocking Home Ability Outfits also grants 15+ corresponding furniture sketches.[/p][p]4. Stardew Valley Encounter Event:[/p][p]Participate in the event-exclusive quest to get the exclusive furniture \[Chicken Gramophone] for free.[/p][p]5. Home Sentiments:[/p][p]The Furniture Edition of Heartfelt Gifts is here! Starting from the event launch, you can unlock 1 free furniture item per day. The event lasts 3 days, so stylists can collect a total of 3 free furniture pieces. This event will run for 3 consecutive rounds.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: I see the Heartfelt Gifts event is back![/p][p]This round of the Heartfelt Gifts brings three uniquely charming furniture pieces for everyone![/p][p]Stylists probably have already seen in the video that this round of Heartfelt Gifts will give out the Wish Pop Chair, Whimstar Lamp, and Bom-Bom Potted Plant. These lovely Home items will be gradually unlocked for free once the event starts. Heartfelt Gifts are packed with sincerity, helping stylists decorate their new homes in style.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://webstatic.infoldgames.com/7d325eec933f05b1/images/bg/J7kfIG4znu7kBHJK.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Q: Are there other ways to get furniture?[/p][p]1. In the Dreamland Showcase, stylists can complete Weekly Chronicle Tasks to earn Dreamland Stones. With these Stones, you can exchange not only for the Detective's Study furniture set (15 pieces in total, can be exchanged multiple times), but also for rewards like Diamonds and Energy Crystals. Additionally, signing the Dreamland Pact with 680 Stellarites will instantly grant the brand-new furniture Loving Fufu & Flowers along with its furniture sketch. Once you accumulate a specified amount of Dreamland Stones during this Showcase event, the previously spent 680 Stellarites will be fully refunded.[/p][p]2. Stylists can also get Home furniture by purchasing gift packs in the Store. Each pack includes one or more pieces of the same type for basic placement. The Store also offers options to buy individual furniture items. Details on single-item prices will be shared in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://webstatic.infoldgames.com/7d325eec933f05b1/images/bg/ZhGZChGnaaxGDxJr.png"][/img][/p][p]Q: Is there a limit on how many fields I can place?[/p][p]While the number of starter fields is capped, once the Ability Level Evaluation reaches level 25, stylists can purchase additional fields from the Yardling Shop using Astralites. More fields will unlock for purchase as the overall level rises. In addition, free fields can be earned as planting ability improves. As long as it's under your Homes overall load, you can keep planting your fields to your heart's content![/p][p][/p][p]Q: Can we build more than one house? I want to try out different styles![/p][p]Of course! There's no limit to how many houses you can build in your Home. In addition to the countryside style already available, new architectural styles are in development and will be introduced in future updates. To ensure smooth performance, the system uses a load value. Each Home begins with a base limit that increases as the construction ability level rises. The load is consistent across all platforms—PC, mobile, and PlayStation—and does not vary by device. By balancing furniture within this value, stylists can design dream homes, and the load system will continue to be refined based on feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Do furniture pieces have unique interactive effects?[/p][p]Yes! Some furniture comes with special interactive effects. For example, when equipping the Danqing Ability and approaching the Eternal Years Screen, using the ability on it will reveal scenes of the four seasons. Inviting friends to interact with the furniture together also triggers exclusive shared actions. Another example: after placing the Stellar Cascade, entering its designated area allows you to catch falling stars. Meeting other stylists who have also caught stars triggers charming little star explosions. Plenty more delightful surprises await in Home![/p][p][/p][p]Q: When will the cooking system become available in the Home?[/p][p]The cooking system is expected to be introduced soon! Stylists will be able to craft dishes by following recipes. With the right furniture facilities, you can simmer, bake, or mix drinks to create delicious meals. Of course though… if you mess up, you might just end up with some very questionable food instead…[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Can terrain be edited freely in the Home?[/p][p]Absolutely! In the upcoming version of the Home system, stylists will be able to place different terrain blocks, including terraces, cliffs, sparse woodland slopes, ponds, and more. In addition, various trees, rocks, and water features can be arranged to help create a truly one-of-a-kind landscape. Even more surprises await, ready to be discovered by stylists in their own Homes![/p][p][/p][p]Q: Since the Home is built in the sky, is there a height limit for construction?[/p][p]Yes, there is a height limit to ensure smooth performance. At present, construction is capped at 100 meters, giving stylists plenty of freedom to unleash their creativity in the sky. Height restrictions will continue to be monitored and optimized in future updates according to stylist needs.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Can resonance rewards and store-bought decorations be placed in the Home?[/p][p]It depends on item tags. Once the Home system launches, some items will display either a \[Home Furniture] or \[Decoration] tag. Items with the \[Home Furniture] tag can be placed inside the Home, while items with both tags may be placed both in Miraland and the Home. Decorations obtained through Resonance can currently be displayed in the Home as furniture, though only one of each type may be placed. If a Resonance decoration has already been fixed in the Home, placing the same decoration in Miraland will not remove the one in the Home. Tags can be checked in-game for details.[/p]

notes.notes: [p]Every story begins with a connection. Through sun and rain, we're grateful to have met kindred spirits and to travel side by side. As autumn deepens and a new journey begins, even more optimizations are on the way.[/p][p]In the upcoming version, this update focuses on Co-op improvements, enables up to 60 FPS on PS5, and refines the Sea of Stars region, Photo Mode, and Color Lookbook. We hope these updates deliver an even better gameplay experience in the new version.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Co-op Mode: Key Improvements Ahead[/b][/p][p]The journey's long, but it's always better with friends. Since Co-op launched, stylists have shared countless adventures together. Every resonance from the stars and every meaningful illumination mark the start of something new.[/p][p]From in-game and community feedback, we've seen how Co-op turn strangers into warm connections. At the same time, we've also noticed some issues affecting this experience. In response, this new version will include a wide range of Co-op optimizations.[/p][p]First, no more key feature restrictions in Co-op maps. While you're in the Sea of Stars, you can join Mira Crown, check Styling Factions, read the Folklore Guide, and more. You can also enter the Realms to exchange materials or complete Realm of Eureka challenges without leaving the Co-op map.[/p][p]Better quest tracking while in Co-op. In the current version, when you're in Co-op mode or on Co-op maps, the quest panel shows "No Active Co-op Map Quests." After the update, your tracked quests will remain visible. In addition, if you're in single-player, but a quest is blocked by Co-op mode or due to Co-op mode, a quick option to exit Co-op will be available so you can continue progressing without interruption.[/p][p]In the current version, Co-op may fail for various reasons, but the vague prompts often leave stylists unsure of why they can't connect. In upcoming updates, we will gradually ease Co-op restrictions to reduce failures caused by version mismatches or certain in-game states. We will also introduce clearer text prompts that specify the exact reason—such as when a stylist is gliding, riding a vehicle, or preparing for a performance—so stylists can adjust their status and reconnect more easily.[/p][p]In the near term, we're planning to further optimize multiplayer interactions. When multiple Starlit Shadows are in the same Co-op map, interaction icons above characters will use different colors to distinguish actions like hand-holding, illumination, or photo invites. We're also working on faster hand-hold switching, showing friend notes above characters and in interaction panels, and other quality-of-life upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Photo Feature: Quick Delete Function[/b][/p][p]With the new Home feature debuting in Version 1.9, some furniture items will be unlocked through photography. To help you manage your shots, we've [b]added a function to delete photos immediately after taking them[/b]. Took a photo you don't like? Delete it right away to keep your album tidy. After the update, Leila, the camera modification merchant, will also offer new photo poses, so don't forget to stop by and check them out![/p][p][/p][p][b]Color Lookbook: Easier to Try On[/b][/p][p]In previous versions, we improved Color Lookbook recommendations so more standout designs could be seen. Based on your feedback, we're adding a highly requested feature in version 1.9: after[b] importing and saving a Dyeing Scheme from your Lookbook, you can jump straight to the Wardrobe to try it on[/b], making it easier for stylists to put on your ideal looks! In the DIY Workshop, you can [b]easily[/b] [b]remove the current dyeing scheme from a piece of clothing[/b] , making experimentation smoother and more fun.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Graphics optimization: PS5 60 FPS is Here![/b][/p][p]Graphics optimization has always been the priority for our development team.[/p][p]In the new update, we're introducing a Performance Mode option for PS5. Both PS5 and PS5 Pro users can select this mode to enjoy smoother, more responsive gameplay with the frame rate cap raised to 60 FPS. The original 30 FPS option will stay as Graphics Mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/d8b0dc63748462ba190f23187523821e082001fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On PC, Version 1.9 adds support for Intel XeSS super resolution and frame generation. Stylists using AMD and Intel graphics cards will enjoy better overall image clarity.[/p][p]We've also cleaned up the main interface on PC and PS to improve convenience and usability. Buttons are grouped more clearly to better match your play habits. On PS specifically, we've refreshed some button styles, and we will keep tuning them based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Link Your Discord Account[/b][/p][p]Want to casually show you're Miraland's top stylist? Link your Discord account and let your profile do the talking. Once linked, your profile will display key game info so you can show your progress and team up faster with friends.[/p][p]This goes live after the September 2 version update. Set it up via Events - Link Discord Account (or the dedicated linking page). By linking your Discord account with Infinity Nikki, you can display your online status, stylist nickname, Mira Level, server and total playtime—and invite friends to jump straight into the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/1002949e2b2e1fd3089d310afd420ae27c54e314.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Our Response to Recent Concerns[/b][/p][p]We've seen the discussions about leaks and our recent official actions. We'd like to clarify a few points to avoid confusion or misunderstanding, and to apologize where our earlier wording fell short.[/p][p align="start"]Our recent post about "leaks" was intended to reaffirm our stance against unauthorized leaks. The handheld \[Pounding Hammer] is an in-game hammer that symbolizes action against unlawful leaking. It was never aimed at our stylists or the broader community. Of course, if you'd like to take it as a playful outlet aimed at us, we're more than willing to be on the receiving end.[/p][p align="start"]The Infinity Nikki team has always stood together with every stylist who loves the game, and with our community.[/p][p align="start"]Your feedback means the world to us. We've received your suggestions, and our team is carefully reviewing them to make the necessary adjustments.[/p][p align="start"]As always, we'll keep listening to your feedback and finding ways to make your experience in Miraland with us the best it can be.[/p][p align="start"]The sounds of rustling bamboo and distant music fill the air. A new version is on the way, and Florawish is always ready to welcome new stylists. Follow the music and let's embark on a brand-new adventure together![/p]

notes.title: Behind the Seams | Danqing Season Outfits – The Inspiration Behind the Designs
notes.notes: [p]A white loong rises through clouds and mist, while a celestial figure lingers like a whisper among ink-washed mountains. A spirit cat darts through the forest, its shadow barely seen as the story of dreams painted by brush and ink continues on.[/p][p]From the half-mask that radiates the might of the Loong, to the flowing sleeves that capture the elegance of an immortal. From bold floral hairpins and fluttering butterflies to feline grace hidden in the details. This set of five-star outfits captures the spirit of Danqing Season. Inspired by the fated encounter between the White Loong and the Spirit Cat, each look blends traditional silhouettes with fresh accessories, clever color palettes, and imaginative abilities.[/p][p]Now, let’s take a closer look as we unveil the creative journey behind the Danqing Season five-star outfits![/p][p][/p][p][b]⭐Forever Bond[/b][/p][p][b]The Story Behind the Outfit[/b][/p][p]Observations of Yin Yuan[/p][p]The ink in my inkstone is running low again.[/p][p]This morning, I added a new stone mill west of the village. By afternoon, I painted a few shallow riverbanks upstream. I can capture the shapes of mountains and the flow of rivers but the invisible, unbreakable threads of Yin Yuan connecting them are something my brush cannot trace.[/p][p]Yet by the stream, two White Egrets have, for as long as I can remember, rested on the same stone, even spreading their wings in perfect unison. The newly painted stone arch bridge reveals its perfect reflection only when the moon is at its peak, mirroring the moon in the sky. A bamboo raft tied at the shore is gently pushed by the night breeze, drifting slowly toward a cluster of fresh reeds. Everything is silent, yet fate quietly grows in the stillness.[/p][p]I paint every day and light my lamp every night. I have captured clouds blown by the breeze and wisteria twisting around tree trunks. Every brushstroke hopes to awaken a connection, not seeking anything extraordinary, just letting my brush follow my heart, flowing with the pulse of nature until figures appear between mountains and rivers.[/p][p]At first, people walked the earth barefoot, feeling the warmth of stones and listening to the sound of flowing water, eyes wide with wonder at all the world’s mysteries. I stayed behind the scenes, only painting a bush of berries for them to eat or a campfire on a cold riverbank to keep them warm.[/p][p]Gradually, people gathered.[/p][p]They learned language and identified plants, humming simple songs between work and rest. They settled by the streams, built houses, and lit the first smoke rising from kitchens. Sometimes I left my marks too, hiding clever weaving patterns and blacksmith’s chants carved into cliff crevices for the right person to find.[/p][p]This painted village, born from countless fateful encounters, slowly grew from a faint ink dot beneath my brush into a living place of laughter and tears, reunions and farewells.[/p][p]Stories give this place its spirit and fate makes it eternal.[/p][p]I believe that as long as these two remain, even if I someday vanish from this world, this place will renew itself, endlessly alive.Thinking this, I put down my brush and returned to Loong Peak.[/p][p]The sun was warm and the bamboo charcoal was roasting five-spice pork. The mingling scents of tea and meat brought comfort.[/p][p]Mo Doudou clutched his abacus and ran out with a tap tap tap. Ms. Mo paused in organizing her scrolls. Even the usually lazy Mo Yu leaned against the doorframe and smiled, saying, “Welcome home.”[/p][p]Yue Bai, practicing her calligraphy, set down her brush. She looked up, startled for a moment, then her clear eyes curved like the moon as she smiled warmly at me.[/p][p]At that moment, the wind was warm, flowers bloomed, and the world was full of things to cherish.[/p][p]But I knew I would eventually leave.[/p][p]I only hope that when we meet again, this world will have flourished and the painted realm will have become real. The inhabitants would remain unchanged, hearts as pure as ever, and all will be well.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Inspiration Behind the Design[/b][/p][p]On the night of a full moon deep within the palace, a Spirit Cat who has lived for over a hundred years is transforming. Soft light from a lantern dances over her fluffy tail and the layers of her intricate outfit, casting waves of pink and red that bloom like vibrant flowers. This bold color imagery was our vision from the very start.[/p][p]Rather than depicting a fully grown mystical creature, the art team aimed to capture the youthful spirit of a newly transformed Spirit Cat during a time of prosperity. She carries a hint of mischief but still seems innocent and curious. The elaborate costumes serve as her essential disguise. Through the shifting layers of her attire, she blends seamlessly into the human world while holding onto her true kitten nature.[/p][p]The Spirit Cat’s design draws heavily from the Linqing Lion Cat breed, so compared to short-haired cats, she appears noticeably fluffier.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/f96287bb2428c451ee6057df3a1abe1ff1cd68ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Details in the Design[/b][/p][p][b]Outerwear[/b][/p][p]The most striking feature of the Forever Bond outerwear is its layered sheer sleeves, each tier fading from deep red to soft pink. Delicate gold and silver floral patterns shimmer across the fabric, while the edges are shaped like flower petals, giving the garment the feeling of a blooming epiphyllum in a time of flourishing beauty.[/p][p]Two large flowers embroidered on the shoulders add an enchanting, otherworldly touch. Along with the four long silk ribbons trailing behind, the outfit perfectly captures the Spirit Cat’s graceful and lively movements during gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/e44e2a4482ab63fd8dbf91c9701e6a4b6a935d9f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Dress[/b][/p][p]For the dress design, we focused on incorporating petals and butterfly elements. The butterfly on the chest features intricate and lavish embroidery, with three overlapping layers of wings that enhance the outfit’s overall delicacy.[/p][p]The petal-shaped sheer skirt balances the richness of the chest embroidery, adding a touch of lightness and graceful softness to the ensemble.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/43a37b5b0f86e772ef7ee000b38bec11c9d1d1cf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Shoes[/b][/p][p]For the shoes, we took a fresh approach by replacing traditional heels with swirling cloud effects. Walking barefoot on tiptoe adds to the Spirit Cat’s light and delicate steps, just like a real cat.[/p][p]Paired with ornate golden bangles and bells on the ankles, plus shimmering gold tattoos on the legs, every step jingles softly, highlighting the lively and spirited nature of the Spirit Cat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/6953f8176195cb8993a6ef053216487e9d945b09.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hair Accessories[/b][/p][p]The elaborate blooming flowers echo the decorations on the shoulders and appear in clusters giving the impression that the Spirit Cat is hiding among the blossoms.[/p][p]The four long hairpins at the back combined with the cat ears create a silhouette from the front that subtly resembles cat whiskers. This effect is designed to give players that instant cat whisker impression.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/756b818574c5f1ca060f203681445f8a7ea072c6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Concept Behind the Abilities[/b][/p][p]The overall design centers on the Spirit Cat as the core inspiration combined with the identity of an artist to enrich the abilities further.[/p][p]When wearing this outfit the cat’s traits show up in every detail from unique purification actions to dashing. (Cat’s OS: Hooman, you’re just too slow. I’m so much faster!)[/p][p]When unleashing the ultimate skill the Spirit Cat paints just like a kitten after catching a small enemy she quickly scratches and creates a masterpiece by this genius little cat artist.[/p][p]Behind every cat painting is a story of sunrises and full moons seen during journeys with the White Loong, along with memories of gentle spring breezes and autumn leaves.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/75f5bdb0a687dcf88c82481aa41b3608cf6efb33.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]⭐Clouded Loong[/b][/p][p][b]The Story Behind the Outfit[/b][/p][p]Awaiting Tomorrow - Part I[/p][p]Long ago, she left in a hurry, leaving me behind with no word of when she would return.[/p][p]This world bears the traces of her brushstrokes. I walk alone among them, following her old footsteps, recalling the sound of her voice and her presence.[/p][p]I still remember her teaching: “If you see a child lost, guide them home. If you see an elder burdened, lend a hand. If neighbors quarrel, speak kindly to soothe. Never let fate be broken by harsh words.”[/p][p]I have faithfully followed her words, one by one. At first, I did not grasp their deep meaning, but seeing the village filled with laughter and joy, I now understand that fate is like plants. It grows and spreads when nourished by rain and dew.[/p][p]The fate she hoped for is not just a few brush marks on paper but a greeting, a lantern’s light, a glance exchanged. These are things I once had but can no longer reach.[/p][p]Since she left, cold moons and warm days have passed, and the years stretch long and bitter.[/p][p]Suddenly the Yin Yuan Festival arrives again, and this time, I stand alone on the high platform.[/p][p]I watch the crowds weave together, people exchanging gifts and holding hands in promise. I wanted to send her wishes in their place, but amid the noisy cheers, my heart felt lost. Everyone paired off, but I stand solitary. The festive bustle around me feels distant and meaningless.[/p][p]In that moment, unsure how to express myself, I forced a faint smile just like she used to.[/p][p]About to leave, I suddenly saw an elder guiding a child beneath the corridor, pointing to scriptures and speaking gently. In that moment, I felt transported back to Loong Peak. She was once like this too, teaching me to read, understand, and be courteous. Her voice engraved deep within, every word etched on my heart.[/p][p]The child finished learning, waved happily, and said, “See you tomorrow.”[/p][p]Tomorrow is such an ordinary word yet it weighed heavily in my ears.[/p][p]As the sun set, I watched them go, realizing everyone longs for tomorrow. Children to learn new things, lovers to journey side by side, even old men beneath the eaves hoping for the warm sun again.[/p][p]But the tomorrow I long for, where is it?[/p][p]Which tomorrow will bring me to her again?[/p][p][/p][p]Awaiting Tomorrow - Part II[/p][p]Dear Nikki,[/p][p]As I put pen to paper, the flowers beneath the tower cast gentle shadows and the wind whispers softly through the branches. For some reason, I suddenly felt compelled to write to you.[/p][p]When I first set up this classroom, I worried no one would come. Yet many villagers have gathered, each bound by fate in their own way.[/p][p]Some have misunderstandings to mend and hope to reconcile. Some feel uncertain about the path ahead and seek comforting words. Others, like the children, are curious about what it means to care for someone.[/p][p]Every time I help them find answers, it feels like a mirror reflecting my own heart. In my dreams at night, after so long, I find peace from past troubles.[/p][p]Lately, I have grown closer with the villagers.[/p][p]An aunt once said I looked too frail, afraid I might be blown over by the wind. At first, I didn’t understand, but now I see her words were out of care.[/p][p]Some mischievous children picked wildflowers to give me. Their words were blunt but their intentions sincere.[/p][p]A quiet neighbor often leaves a bundle of fresh firewood at my door.[/p][p]Looking back, I was like a kite with its string cut, drifting aimlessly in an invisible wind, unsure where I would land.[/p][p]But the bond I formed with you has been a lifeline, pulling me back from endless wandering to this shore of the mortal world.[/p][p]Now, I have a name I cherish in my heart and a place where I long to stay. Though my days are busy, my heart feels anchored, my steps purposeful, my thoughts full of hope.[/p][p]I walk among all living beings, so how can I fear the high mountains and long roads?[/p][p]There are a thousand words I wish to say, but paper can barely hold a fraction of them.[/p][p]What I desire most is this — to see you again tomorrow.[/p][p]With deepest respect,[/p][p]Yue Bai[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Inspiration Behind the Design[/b][/p][p]The Clouded Loong outfit draws inspiration from the immortal White Loong. The art team blended the mysterious majesty of Loongs from ancient legends with the ethereal grace of immortals. They also took cues from the use of negative space in traditional landscape paintings, combining the Loong’s strength with the immortal’s lightness to highlight the outfit’s noble aura both divine and elegant.[/p][p]The entire set is based on white with blue accents. It features sharp-edged masks paired with soft, silky fabrics, transforming the wearer into a being that is between a Loong and an immortal. As the dress flows with every step, it brings to life the magnificent imagery of Eastern mythology.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/1b22dea9fbcb9e50787de62370e15dbd2d653c6a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Details in the Design[/b][/p][p][b]Outerwear[/b][/p][p]The design of the outerwear highlights the long multicolored silk ribbons at the chest and the trailing auspicious clouds at the back. The use of lightweight gauze softens the otherwise formal and imposing inner layer, adding more depth and layers to the overall atmosphere of the outfit. When viewed from behind, the hem of the outerwear features a landscape design: green mountains in the center with clouds on either side. Above these, the colorful ribbons represent the glowing light of the mountain peaks. If you look all the way to the top, you'll see a majestic Loong standing on the mountain surrounded by glowing clouds—a breathtaking sight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/74d157049bd8a6ce3db0cdb09648f46c37e6bf58.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Dress[/b][/p][p]The neckline design draws inspiration from the traditional Hanfu style with crossed collars and wide sleeves. The cuffs are shaped like a dragon’s body and feature subtle patterns of a soaring dragon weaving through the clouds. The water sleeves at the edges add a touch of misty cloudiness to the overall look.[/p][p]The dress features a layered sheer design inspired by Chinese mountain landscapes. The innermost layer of the dress is adorned with delicate gold dragon scale ornaments, giving the garment a refined yet luxurious feel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/ccc2072e9f5d4d148edbb7dfd39ef9c1e4b4ae35.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Handheld[/b][/p][p]The Loong-shaped mask is designed as a half-face cover with sharp, striking lines and intricate, mysterious patterns. Soft feathers trim the edges, blending strength with gentleness. From the feathers extend mist-like cloud effects that shimmer with a pale blue glow when touched by light.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/45493001e58264bbab85c9fd8152fab337d4e9ad.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Headwear[/b][/p][p]The round crown features a winding Loong weaving through the mountains, highlighting the traditional style of the outfit. Behind the crown, silver effects inspired by drifting clouds and mist add an airy yet elegant touch to the design.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/cf06af12f7d1e86cae40dbbdcc55cb6ecbf03630.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Concept Behind the Abilities[/b][/p][p]The ability design for the Clouded Loong outfit draws inspiration from the adventures of two close friends exploring mountains and rivers. When the immortal summons the White Loong, it marks a warm reunion. As they soar through clouds and mist, the White Loong shares breathtaking views with its companion. For places beyond reach, an orb imbued with the White Loong's energy will be left, allowing rapid travel to its location for future opportunities to journey together once more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/9f5f49058305ed45a76c8a671986e3b5af4c9ced.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ★Miraland Round Table★
notes.notes: [p]Hey stylists, got your favorite cup of tea in hand? Then sit back, get comfy, and hold it close. Our second episode of Miraland Round Table is about to begin! [/p][p]We've reviewed the latest feedback from our stylists, gathering your most pressing questions and top concerns. We're excited to share some behind-the-scenes progress, along with a glimpse of what's coming next—from highly requested features to brand-new content still in development. We've also got a few fresh updates just for you~ [/p][p]Moving forward, we'll continue listening to your feedback and working to improve the game every step of the way. Let's keep building a better Miraland—together![/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Update the main story already! Give us a new map![/b] Updates to the main story are on the way! Today, we're giving you a quick look at what's coming in the versions ahead. In Version 1.8, a brand-new area will be unveiled. Then in Version 1.9, stylists will finally get the long-awaited Home feature. Plus, a new story will unfold as a theater troupe visits the Bibcoon's Chuckle Club. Nikki's adventures with both new and familiar friends across Miraland will continue to unfold gradually through Versions 1.10 and 1.11. Looking ahead to Version 2.0, Nikki will arrive at the breathtaking Elderwood Forest and the city of Spira—fresh regions filled with new stories, Ability Outfits, and exciting map gameplay. Compared to existing areas, exploration and interaction in Version 2.0 will be even richer. From embarking on an adventure aboard a raft crafted by the Shroomlings to riding an adorable Snail, Nikki's life is about to become full of new thrills and surprises. Stylists, join Nikki in building a forever home and get ready for a brand-new journey across Miraland![/p][p][/p][p][b]2. When will we be able to dye individual items? We need it for five-star pieces![/b] Yes! It's already in the works! Individual piece dyeing is currently in development and expected to start rolling out in Version 1.11. We can't wait to see how stylists transform classic looks and dye their way to a style that's uniquely their own~[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. We hope future outfit pieces are designed with mix-and-match in mind—too many just don't pair well with others when creating custom looks.[/b] We've been carefully listening to your feedback about outfit pieces. In upcoming versions, we'll put even greater focus on designing pieces with mix-and-match flexibility and practicality in mind. Our goal is to make every piece more versatile and useful, so you can create more unique outfits and make every item in your wardrobe both practical and stylish~ [b]4. Will previous 5-star outfits get alternate detail options?[/b] Absolutely—it's well under way! All five-star outfits from previous versions (including Sea of Stars, Wishful Aurosa, Silvergale's Aria, and so on) will receive exclusive alternate detail options, along with new makeup and animations at the last phase of evolution. These updates will roll out gradually in future versions. That being said, these updates are still in development and may require some time before release. We kindly ask our stylists to wait patiently—once we've meticulously polished every detail, we'll unveil the dazzling new transformations for everyone to experience together! Without further ado, here's an exclusive first look at the new details for the Wishful Aurosa outfit. What do you think, stylists?[/p][p][/p][p][b]5. Could you please group the original, glowed up, and evolved versions of outfits together? The wardrobe is starting to feel a bit cluttered![/b] It's already on our calendar—wardrobe organization is in progress! As your wardrobe continues to grow, many stylists have collected multiple versions of the same outfit, which can sometimes make sorting and searching a bit challenging. To make styling easier and more enjoyable, we plan to improve wardrobe sorting in upcoming versions by grouping different color variants of the same outfit together—creating a more organized and user-friendly experience. We'll continue to listen closely to your feedback and enhance the wardrobe display, so finding your favorite pieces and crafting stunning looks is smoother and more fun than ever before![/p][p][/p][p][b]6. Will the Home feature include a cooking function? We're excited to start cooking—and Nikki's getting hungry too![/b] Yes, stylists—absolutely! After the Home feature launches, we'll gradually roll out new gameplay elements and functions—including the long-awaited cooking system. Stylists will be able to select ingredients and experiment with recipes to whip up delicious creations, from savory dishes to sweet desserts and refreshing drinks. Once prepared, food can be exchanged for home-related currency or proudly put on display. Nikki can also enjoy these tasty meals to gain a variety of helpful benefits. But that's not all! You'll be able to invite friends over to share dishes. These friendly get-togethers might even spark new inspiration and unlock fresh recipes! We hope the cooking system adds a cozy new aspect to your adventures in Miraland—so you and Nikki can slow down, unwind, and savor life's gentler moments~[/p]

notes.title: Behind the Scenes Special: A First Look at the Home Feature
notes.notes: [p]The cicadas are singing, the summer sun is blazing, and the rainy season has finally passed. As early summer rolls in, we have been working hard behind the scenes to bring you the very latest on one of the most anticipated updates yet—the Home feature, arriving in version 1.9! So... what does Nikki's home look like? What adventures and possibilities will the Home unveil? Let's take a sneak peek at what's in store![/p][p][/p][h3]Sneak Peek: Welcome to Your Home![/h3][p]The Home is Nikki's personal sanctuary—a space where she can finally rest amidst her many adventures. From the gentle town of Florawish, Nikki's journey began. She's wandered through Breezy Meadow, with fields alive with wildflowers and the hum of cicadas, climbed Stonetrees towering above the clouds, and walked among endless Aurosa meadows shimmering beneath the sun. With every step forward, she's discovered new stories and forged heartfelt bonds—but the road ahead remains full of surprises and adventures yet to come. And so, the Home was born—a quiet haven just for her. A place to pause, to breathe, to welcome in friends old and new... and, when the time is right, to set out once more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/276a158a96f486432b18a441f2f3165e5f3a28ff.png"][/img]*Concept art shown: final design is subject to change.[/p][p][/p][p]Nikki's Home isn't just a house—it's a heart-shaped floating island, thoughtfully crafted with multiple themed zones. At its core lies a peaceful lake and a colossal flowering tree. Beneath this tree sits Nikki's cozy cottage, tucked within a sea of flowers. And the journey to reach this sanctuary is just as magical—on your first visit, you'll ride a small boat upstream through floating petals, down a path lined with blooming groves, and arrive at the central dock beneath the grand tree.[/p][p]Beyond the central flower field, the island features multiple biomes and terrains—forests, lakes, mountains, and more—each area waiting to be unlocked and discovered as you explore and grow your Home.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/eeed93abb68d748f6059bf3153d6535ab02973ef.jpg"][/img]*Concept art shown: final design is subject to change.[/p][p][/p][h3]A First Glimpse: The Dock Area[/h3][p]The dock area is the heart of daily life and quiet wonder. Here, you'll meet the island's native residents: a charming group of fairies who've made this place their home. You'll find their footprints tucked in the moss, their handiwork scattered in every corner—thoughtful surprises prepared just for Nikki. Trade with them for furniture blueprints, manage your Home, and uncover their lovingly crafted wares. There's even a cozy pavilion nearby where gifts left by friends for Nikki will be on display. And don't miss the resting gardens—unique plants grow there slowly over time, offering rare resources and a glimpse into the rhythm of island life.[/p][p][/p][h3]So, How Does It All Work?[/h3][p]When designing the home gameplay, we wanted every moment to feel peaceful, rewarding, and delightfully unhurried. That's why the core themes we centered on are "A Joyful, Carefree Life" and "Unleashing Whim Through Infinite Creation." To bring this vision to life, we gave stylists the freedom to shape their experience their way. Whether you want to build, decorate, plant, collect—or just spend time soaking in the view—it's all up to you. Every corner of your home can reflect your own style and creativity, turning Nikki's home into a place that feels truly and uniquely yours.[/p][p]So—what exactly can you do in your home? We thought you might ask. Here's a sneak peek at just a few of the magical abilities and cozy features waiting for you in version 1.9![/p][p][/p][p][b]Planting:[/b] Turn your garden into a sea of life. Plant seeds, tend to your crops, and watch flowers bloom in full color. If you're lucky, something extra-special might blossom too...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/2b9b1dc229a521b68e9669335d8076f0f7651377.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fishkeeping:[/b] Drop some fishlings into your pond and wait for them to grow, ripple by ripple. Rumor has it, the little fairies at the docks are on the lookout for certain rare fish—perhaps they'll offer you something neat in return?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/a1325b97ad3d93280b203d20eb75151fe55d7b88.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Crafting:[/b] Collect blueprints, gather materials, and bring your dream home to life—one sofa, lamp, or wall panel at a time! From furniture to flooring to full-on renovations, your creativity is the limit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/d6c7d8d9a1303bf9f942a06424bbcfd797bfd530.png"][/img]  [/p][p][b]Construction:[/b] With your Construction ability unlocked, you'll be able to move, rotate, and adjust every piece of furniture with precision.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/96b144953867d1f617efd08fd7204cc407a217c6.png"][/img]  [/p][p][b]Ability Combination:[/b] Float Mode? When you combine your Construction and Floating abilities... wait—why is that swing set in the sky? And is that house... hovering? Looks like things are about to get very whimsical.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/95a70466a4dd74dbb5ea786f2e6cee965acdee46.png"][/img]  [/p][p]And that's just the beginning. As your Home evolves, even more extraordinary combinations will unlock—many deeply tied to the open world. Blend Home Abilities with those Nikki discovered across Miraland, and discover truly synergistic magic.[/p][p]The power of Whim... kind of magical, isn't it?[/p][p][/p][h3]Decorate Your Way! A First Look at Fun Furniture Items[/h3][p]Whether you're sprucing up your floating island or decking out the interior of your dream home, furniture plays a huge role in making your space truly one of a kind. And guess what? There are multiple ways to get your hands on these charming pieces! Some blueprints can be earned as you build up you Home, while others are hidden throughout the open-world—just waiting for observant stylists to track them down. Of course, you'll have your cozy beds and comfy chairs, but we've also picked out a few extra-fun standouts to share:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/40182575495a2988232437acfd7ee289fbfd7e27.png"][/img]  [/p][p]*Concept art shown: final design is subject to change.[/p][p][/p][p]Photo Frame: Cherish your journey! Ever since the first sneak peek of the Home system, we've been closely watching your feedback—and construction difficulty has definitely been a hot topic. Going forward, even more visitors will be welcome—like your story companions! With a strong enough bond, they can join Nikki for a relaxing visit or even settle in for a while. You'll be able to decorate guest spaces and share moments of peaceful island life.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/b2d81c5cb905443f27834d0ed30fc57448dbe626.png"][/img]  [/p][p]*Concept art shown: final design is subject to change.[/p][p][/p][p]The Home system is huge, and today's preview only scratched the surface.
