Drop them in the comments—we're all ears! Your dreams and suggestions help shape the experience, and we're committed to making it better with every step. Let's build magic—together.[/p]

notes.title: Behind the Seams | [Tide of Tears] The Inspiration Behind the Design
notes.notes: [p][b]The Story[/b][/p][p]Blue of Eternal Nights[/p][p]Dark as the ancient watery abyss, the cavern stood where time had frozen.[/p][p]Her scales had long since become one with the green moss climbing onto the shore and the Blue Tears' ebb and flow. When pain pierced her, she lifted her gaze to the splendid gown exiled to its high perch. The gem formed from the very first Blue Tear swayed gently, singing the sobs of the past.[/p][p]Then her massive skeleton curled tight—a cage within a cage—firmly trapping the soul clinging to its guilt.[/p][p]Round and round the gem revolved. Her serpent tail began to scrape involuntarily against the etchings on the stone wall—those crude lines carved long ago with her dearest friend, crooked as the routes the friend once traced on the grass when they first met.[/p][p]Back then, she silently embroidered every twist and turn of their journey onto her garment, so she would never forget the joy.[/p][p]"Get out there, and you can see the whole field!"[/p][p]The babbling stream chimed like her friend's voice—a time-lost dream, half-remembered yet achingly tender. She took human form then, bare feet tentative on the damp stone steps, each touch an echo of forgotten grace. The newly made soft robe trailed after her. When the thorny crown tore her friend's already frayed cloak, the icy wind carried sparks of tiny flames.[/p][p]"The field under moonlight is beautiful. Even without moonlight, there are little glowing insects called Glimmerdrops back in my hometown," her friend said, unconcerned, patting her cloak. "Just a few, and they could light up the entire night sky!"[/p][p]Round and round the gem revolved—she remembers everything, including this beautiful, pitiful wish. Yet the moonless night outlasted all imagining. What they'd dreamed would set the fields aglow faded grain by grain.[/p][p]The weeping in the ghostly green wilds never ceased. Those people she couldn't have saved, those roars born of treachery—year after year, they seeped from her sorrow, flowing into her memory.[/p][p]When the sun ceased to rise, she saw it. She saw the Woolfruit that was pressed into her arms rotting in her embrace. And the drowning mother's last clutch at her long veil—a breath against silk, lighter than a Glimmerdrop's sigh.[/p][p]The deepest wound still coiled over her heart.[/p][p]When death pierced her friend's chest, she saw it. She saw the wreath they had dreamed of together in the harvest season—vibrant, lush, once held against countless chests, passing on a light that seemed it would never fade.[/p][p]Now tiny flames drifted near again. She knew it was the patrolling stylists reinforcing the seal; that friend who had guided her was about to leave her dream.[/p][p]Round and round the gem revolved. She struggled violently, rusted chains scraping off flesh—and so she awakened. She remembered she still had unatoned sins to bear.[/p][p]The undercurrent carried away a scarred serpent scale. The scale glimmered faintly into the night—like dying ember-glow from Wishfield's bonfire.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Inspiration Behind the Design[/b][/p][p]In the shadowy marshes dwells a serpentine lady with pale skin and an aura of noble elegance. This outfit draws core inspiration from serpent motifs and the faintly glowing Shimmer Pond. To retain the serpent's dangerously ethereal essence while ensuring the snake-themed design remains approachable for players, the outfit primarily features flowing black fabric with a cool, emerald sheen for the gown's foundation. Gemstone-like highlights accentuate scaled textures, simulating the luster of embedded jewels. Combined with the lugubrious wetland setting, these details create an overall shimmering effect—as if the outfit has just emerged from water. Though serpents symbolize peril, our design avoids conveying pure menace or malice. Instead, it emphasizes their otherworldly elegance. Building on this vision, the art team integrated the Blue Tears with the marsh's subtle luminescence, culminating in a serpentine-themed outfit that harmonizes aesthetic beauty with thematic authenticity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/307f6ec64560bb0d6acc7725d48e54b9dcba0a7d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Details Behind the Design[/b][/p][p]\[Outerwear: Cold Jade][/p][p]The outerwear piece's silhouette mimics a serpent's sinuous form. When moving forward, it coils behind the wearer like a snake's wake—fluid yet forbidding. To emulate serpentine texture, the fabric features subtle green iridescence with scale-patterned highlights. This maintains the otherworldly aesthetic while enhancing textual fidelity.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/df7bb3b70f27dfbfc972301730e724cc294dada5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]\[Dress: Deepwater Secrets][/p][p]The dress captures a serpent's essence through structural details: abdominal pleats mimic ventral scales, while the fitted cut echoes a snake's form. Deep teal shot silk replicates the dangerous beauty of snakeskin luster, achieving thematic resonance without literal reptilian motifs. A polished metal chest piece—reminiscent of mage regalia in western fantasy—adds striking contrast with bright metallic accents.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/21411cea6b7e95b930ae65f573bca203801c8f44.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]\[Gloves: Azure Scale][/p][p]Sharpened metallic claws emphasize the non-human identity, revealing lethal power beneath elegance. Iridescent scale patterning along the arms further signals this otherworldly nature.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/401251f9a52226f081c8687d72ee7237d3fba259.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]\[Handheld: Fateful Soul][/p][p]This spellcasting orb swirls with aquatic energy, channeling the marsh's power. Drawing from their grasp of the outfit's essence, the art team crafted the orb with deliberate fractures—yet from each fissure spills a liquid light, where memories pool like unspent tears. The mystic teal gemstone mirrors the outfit's primary hue, its radiance a perilous beauty.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/bd8825773cd79b22d4320e7e17b46996ee5acd0f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Concept Behind the Ability[/b][/p][p]This outfit's ability ties closely into its thematic core. Upon activation, Nikki summons a pool of Blue Tears beneath her, creating an ethereal sanctuary. Water ripples outward in shimmering waves as the pool expands, its surface dancing with luminescent glimmers that ignite like submerged stars. After using the ability, Nikki's skin will transform into an ash-gray serpent-scale hue and iridescent scale patterns will emerge across her body, making her entire form glow with flowing light. If used near fishing spots, it will also attract large schools of fish to linger and listen to her lament together; if this ability is activated within pools of Blue Tears, then even more breathtaking visual effects will appear![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/b370bdec44d5a1c259c934ac67a1dd04794f2763.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Behind the Seams | [Enchanted Encounter] The Inspiration Behind the Design
notes.notes: [p][b]The Story[/b][/p][p](At the break of dawn, a letter falls beside a pillow...)[/p][p][/p][p]To my dearest Fairy Nikki, [/p][p][/p][p]Fairy greetings! Life has been a whirlwind lately with all the preparations for the official Fairy Ceremony, but I've finally found a quiet moment to write you this letter. [/p][p]Did you know your story has spread far and wide across the fairy world? Everyone now calls you the Miracle Fairy, and pink has been crowned the official fairy color of the year! At the Fairy Academy, the little Fairy Apprentices simply can't stop asking me questions—[/p][p]""What is Fairy Nikki's stylomancy?""[/p][p]""Where is the gateway to Miraland?""[/p][p]""How can I get a pudgy, wisecracking, two-legged cat companion like hers?""[/p][p]...and the list goes on![/p][p]So I've decided, rather than leaving them guessing, I should share more about you myself. [/p][p]I have a plan underway. I've noticed many young fairies dyeing their hair pink and wearing fresh silk gowns—clearly trying to emulate your legendary outfit from the day you triumphed over the Slumber Sheep. So, Pappetto and I stayed up all night crafting an exact replica, down to the smallest detail. Now, no fairy will need to worry about whether or not to embroider Momo on their dress! Even the Slumber Sheep lent a paw, generously donating some of its wool. [/p][p]Your fairy outfit is proudly displayed in the Academy's main hall. I enchanted it with a little magic so that anyone who approaches can see your story unfold before their very eyes. The Headmaster says the display draws large crowds of fairies every day! The pink dye is completely sold out. Even the nearby animals are starting to look a little patchy, thanks to all the eager fairies gathering their fur to create their own versions... It must be tough being so popular! [/p][p]Once everything settles down, Pappetto and I will set off on a new adventure! I want to go beyond the fairy world and share your story far and wide with all living beings—so that when you arrive in Dreamvale, you won't feel like a stranger, because everyone will know your name. [/p][p]Now I just need to figure out how to send this letter all the way to Miraland... Don't worry! With the blessing of the Grand Fairy, I will find a way. One morning, perhaps, you'll wake to find this pink letter resting gently by your pillow. [/p][p][/p][p]Your Fairy Sister,[/p][p]Lulukko[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Inspiration Behind the Design[/b][/p][p]"What if there were a fairy who could make all your whimsical wishes come true... (Time to let your imagination run wild!)"[/p][p]That's the inspiration behind this outfit: a fairy who's stepped right out of a storybook and into your world—ready to make dreams come true![/p][p]At first, our art team imagined her as extravagant and radiant, dressed in a dazzling, voluminous gown that shimmered with magic. [/p][p]But as the design evolved, we began to wonder: What would this fairy have worn before becoming a full-fledged Grand Fairy? [/p][p]That question led us down a new path. We chose a bright, dreamy pink palette to give her a more playful, childlike charm—something sweet, lighthearted, and full of wonder. And that's not all! From the very beginning, we wanted to create a different kind of fairy—not the graceful, flawless type, but one who's a little clumsy. Someone who truly wants to help, but sometimes gets adorably confused along the way.[/p][p]That endearing personality even shaped her ability design. Beyond simply looking magical, we wanted her to bring a sense of fun and surprise—something a little unexpected, something a little whimsical.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/e633227ecdda907a0dd03a4c262e1d197228fc8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Details Behind the Design[/b][/p][Dress: Hope's Embrace][p]This dress captures the enchanting themes of starlight and magic woven throughout the garment. The outer skirt features an irregular, aurora-inspired silhouette, while the inner layer is soft tulle shimmering with a galaxy-like iridescence—truly like wearing a dream. Additionally, abundant lace details infuse the gown with lively, delicate accents, adding depth and graceful movement to this piece.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/ce183990fc3df6776e5e440182e3ec7671d66a08.jpg"][/img][/p][Hat: Whispers of Dream][p]This hat's design draws inspiration from the 15th-century hennin headdress, delicately adorned with moons and stars that beautifully echo the fairy's enchanting identity. (Even Momo wears a double-horned hennin—double the charm!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/a6ccaff7ac1bb8cbf76278a9bb424378b63e4597.jpg"][/img][/p][Shoes: Foreign Wanderings][p]Every inch of these magical fairy heels radiates enchantment. Crafted entirely from crystal, as if lifted straight from the pages of a fairy tale, even the heels shimmer with the mesmerizing glow of an aurora nebula.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/d3d23b783e164984ccf2c14cf6ab8e53d901b086.jpg"][/img][/p][Backpiece: Birth of Miracles][p]Drawing inspiration from classic fairy wings, this backpiece transcends traditional forms to embody a vibrant sense of magic and growth. The inner wings shimmer with the radiant hues of an aurora nebula, causing their translucent surfaces to refract an enchanting, otherworldly glow. Every detail glows with starlight, weaving an aura of pure enchantment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/90aaacf8eac9ee81d22ff6444a5daf35f05d5691.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The Concept Behind the Ability[/b][/p][p]The outfit's ability is deeply connected to her role as a "fairy." This kind-hearted and lovable fairy not only helps people fulfill their wishes but also uses starlight and magic to groom little animals. Since she's still learning, her magic occasionally gets a bit out of hand—"Oh! Why are the little animals flying?"[/p][p]After being groomed, some animals sprout tiny fairy wings and receive a star-shaped blessing from the fairy. A few may even perform charming animations—a fun little easter egg for those who take notice.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/199f4354802eaa52d80d177a198402f7dbb50261.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Steam FAQ for Infinity Nikki
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494875/62d485456462aa38255b8fe1c4b97ba3d6193a1d.jpg[/img]

Q: How do I download the game on Steam?
A: Log into Steam, search for "Infinity Nikki," and download the game.
 
Q: Are in-game events and server times in the Steam version the same as other platforms?
A: Yes, the Steam version aligns with the official servers. Stay tuned to in-game announcements and our social media for updates.
 
Q: Can Steam players add friends from the official servers?
A: Yes. Steam players can connect with friends on the same server, just like other platforms.
 
Q: Are the prices of paid content on Steam the same as those on official servers?
A: While the price tiers on Steam generally match those of the official servers, there might be minor differences due to platform-specific policies.
 
Q: Can my PC run Infinity Nikki?
A: Check the system requirements listed on the Steam store page. Meeting the minimum specs lets you play, but recommended specs ensure smoother gameplay.
 
Q: Does the Steam version support community achievements?
A: Yes, completing specific in-game objectives will unlock Steam achievements. For more details, visit the game's Steam page.
 
Q: Does the Steam version support controllers?
A: Yes.
 
Q: Can I play Infinity Nikki on Steam Deck?
A: Yes.
 
Q: What login options are available in the Steam version? Can I use my existing account?
A: The Steam version supports email login. To use an existing account, bind it during the login process. For help, see the Account Binding FAQs below.
 
Q: My Steam account is registered in Mainland China. Can I bind it to an overseas server account?
A: To play on overseas servers, your Steam store region must be set to a country or region outside Mainland China.
 
Account Binding FAQs:
Q: I already have an Infold account. Can I bind it to Steam?
A: Yes.
Select the [Bind with your existing account] button and use the email associated with your Infold account to complete the binding process.
 
I created my Infold account using a third-party method (e.g., Facebook/Google/Apple/PSN). Can I bind it to Steam?
A: Yes.
If your Infold account（logged in via a third-party account）has already linked to an email: Select [Bind with your existing account] and use that email to bind.
If your Infold account（logged in via a third-party account）has no linked email:
Log in to the Infold Account Center. Go to Account Security → Bound Email and link an email not used for any existing Infold account. Return to Steam and select [Bind with your existing account] using the newly linked email.
 
Q: I have an Infold account but want to create a new game account on Steam. What should I do?
A: Register a new Infold Account with an email not associated with any Infold account, and then link it to your Steam account. Once done, you can use the new account to play.
 
Q: I accidentally bound the wrong account. What should I do?
A: Log in to your Infold account at the Infold Account Center and unbind it through [Account Security].
 
Still need help?
Visit our Support Page (https://support-infinitynikki.infoldgames.com/) or email Infinity Nikki support at infinitynikki_cs@infoldgames.com
We're here to assist!
